purpose: Operator-approved, local-only capability catalog for Tri-AI agents.

gated.browser_use: Requires an explicit browser allowlist and an operator-provided model credential. Never reuse interactive browser cookies automatically.
gated.agentmemory: Requires Windows runtime setup plus an operator decision on lifecycle hooks and retention before it may observe sessions.
gated.codebase_memory_mcp: Installable local binary. Add to an agent MCP configuration only after reviewing its generated config diff.
gated.graft: Install only as a separately reviewed MCP/context governor; do not let it override Tri-AI worktree or verification policy.
gated.agency_agents: Persona library only. A task selects a role explicitly; roles do not grant tools or authority.
gated.voicebox_and_voicestudio: Need microphone, model-download, and voice-data-retention consent before activation.
gated.freellmapi: Runs loopback-only. It remains unusable until the operator creates a dashboard account, creates a unified API key, and configures provider credentials.

not_embedded.openviking: AGPL-3.0; do not link into a commercial Tri-AI runtime without a separate licensing decision.
not_embedded.openmontage: AGPL-3.0 and media-production workload; keep as an external tool, not an embedded runtime dependency.
not_embedded.voicestudio: AGPL-3.0 and GPU/model-heavy; keep external until licensing and retention are resolved.
not_embedded.openhands_and_agent_canvas: A second agent platform, not a library Tri-AI should secretly run inside itself.
not_embedded.openmaic: Education product, not a Tri-AI execution capability.
not_embedded.minimind: Model-training learning project, not a dependable production inference lane.
not_embedded.remotion_agent_skills: No declared license at the reviewed revision; do not distribute or activate until licensing is clear.
not_embedded.harness_engineering_template: No declared license at the reviewed revision; use as research, not imported code.
